text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few weeks have passed since Tosen Jordan split her toenail. It hasn't been easy, but she's finally ready for the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Thanks to you helping me take care of it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It'll definitely hold up. At least for the Satsuki Sho.
choice_data_list: I'd like you to keep running after that, too.
I'd like you to keep running after that, too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …I know. That's why I've been extra careful with my nails lately.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But right now… I want to focus on this race.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I know it could get ugly after. This might even be my last go, but…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I still want to be an amazing Umamusume. I made up my mind to devote everything to racing, and I'm not going back on that.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …Oh, it's you. Hah, good. It's not a gamble without some unknowns to spice things up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (That's Nakayama Festa, a gambling lover who joined Tracen at the same time as Tosen Jordan.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Am I wrong? I was betting you wouldn't show up today.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? But why? I've been super hyped for today!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well… let's just say, train long enough and you get to witness certain happenings.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And yet, you showed up. I wonder how the Goddesses' dice will fall…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Dice? Oh, like sugoroku? I love that game! You too? How funny.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah… I get it. You've got the same stink of stupid as she does…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Who're you calling stupid?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: The kind of stupid that would flip the gameboard over and throw fish on it. …Ah, well.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: The dice were cast when you showed up. They said the Oka Sho on the Tiara tour would be the hottest table this year, but…

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Looks like they were wrong. Haha… This is the real beginning.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …Guess I just have to go with the flow. You've come prepared, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What was that all about? What "beginning"?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well… I guess that might be the case for some…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …But I'm gonna do this!
